course.title: Power Plant Engineering
course.department: Department of Energy Science and Engineering

content.value:
. A generation station has a maximum demand of 25 MW, a load factor of 60%, a plant 09   
capacity factor of 50%, and a plant use factor of 74%. Find (i) the reserve capacity of the   
plant, (ii) the daily energy produced, and (iii) maximum energy that could be produced   
daily if the plant while running as per schedule, were fully loaded.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2023
